description_en: You can call the CheckZoneName operation to check whether a zone name is available

kebab_example: aliyun pvtz check-zone-name --lang en --zone-name example.com --user-client-ip 127.0.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckZoneName

en: English

parameters.help_en: The name of the zone. This parameter is required

parameters.name: user_client_ip

true: The zone name can be added.
